title: Potato and Egg Salad
subtitle: Waxy potatoes and hard-boiled egg in a light mayonnaise dressing
excerpt: Waxy potatoes cut into chunks with quartered hard-boiled eggs, dressed in mayonnaise loosened with a little Dijon and cider vinegar. Good with cold meats, for picnics, or alongside grilled fish.
sourceNotes: Potato and egg salad appears in British and American summer cookery throughout the 20th century. The combination of hard-boiled egg with dressed potato is found in French and German salad traditions. The mayonnaise version became the British picnic standard from the mid-20th century.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Cook the potatoes and eggs up to a day ahead. Dress within 2 hours of serving.

content.text: Potato and egg salad is a simple picnic dish that earns its place by being satisfying and easy to transport. Waxy potatoes hold their shape when cut; floury ones break up and turn the salad into mash. The egg adds protein and richness. The dressing needs enough mustard and vinegar to cut through both.

Put the potatoes in a pan of cold salted water. Bring to the boil and cook for 15 to 18 minutes, until a knife slides in without resistance. Drain and leave to steam dry for 5 minutes, then cut into 3 cm chunks while still warm.
Lower {{eggs}} eggs into boiling water and cook for 10 minutes. Transfer to cold water. Peel when cool and quarter.

Whisk together {{mayonnaise}} of mayonnaise, {{cider-vinegar}} of cider vinegar, {{dijon-mustard}} of Dijon mustard, {{sea-salt-fine}} of salt and {{black-pepper}} of pepper. Toss the warm potato chunks in the dressing. The potato absorbs the dressing better while warm. Leave to cool, then fold in the quartered eggs and spring onion. Scatter parsley over the top if using.

items.symptom: Potatoes break up in the dressing
items.cause: Used a floury potato (Maris Piper, King Edward) rather than a waxy one.
items.fix: Use Charlotte or any waxy salad potato. If using a floury potato, cook and cool completely before cutting, then handle gently.

items.cause: Potatoes were not dressed while warm.
items.fix: Always dress potato salad while the potato is still warm. Cold potato does not absorb dressing.

content.text: Potato and egg salad sits in the practical category of British picnic and buffet cooking. It travels well, keeps for a day in the fridge, and needs no reheating. The egg is what elevates it from a plain potato salad to something more satisfying.
